page.overview:
Who is Alak?

Alak was a human he was wanted in about twenty systems.

On a mission to investigate if the pirate hunters were planning a move on the pirates, Alak fell in love with pirate hunter Raf Thatchburn. Alak passed away long before 229 BBY.

The twentieth issue of the 2023 comic series Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures depicts Alak as alive and present on Eriadu after the end of the Nihil conflict. This, however, conflicts with the novel The High Republic: Escape from Valo, which had previously established that Alak had died long before its events, which take place in 229 BBY.

Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia
